name: @bachs/cli
description: Forward live Bachs webhook events to your local machine
author: Bachs <support@bachs.io>
//: The CLI is a Go binary. This package is only a launcher: the real executables ship as optional platform-specific dependencies, and npm installs exactly the one matching the host. That is how a compiled CLI reaches Node developers without asking them to install Go — the same approach Stripe uses.
